title: Q-OIL: Optimistic Exploration in Learning from Human Interventions
description:
arXiv:2611.08576v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As robots are deployed in the real world, they will inevitably make mistakes. Human interventions provide valuable feedback for improving their behavior, enabling them to adapt online to new scenarios. However, studying human-in-the-loop robot learning is difficult: real-world experiments are slow and expensive, so most algorithm development relies on simulated human models.
